def get_course(latitude_1: float, longitude_1: float, latitude_2: float,
    longitude_2: float, loxodromic: bool=True) ->float:
    """
    Calculate the course (bearing) between two points.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    latitude_1, longitude_1: float
        Starting point coordinates in degrees
    latitude_2, longitude_2: float
        Ending point coordinates in degrees
    loxodromic: bool
        If True, calculate rhumb line course (loxodromic)
        If False, calculate great circle course (orthodromic)
    
    Returns
    -------
    float
        Course in degrees (0-360), where 0 is North, 90 is East, etc.
    """
    # Handle case where both points are the same
    if latitude_1 == latitude_2 and longitude_1 == longitude_2:
        return 0
    
    if loxodromic:
        # Rhumb line (loxodromic) course calculation
        lat1 = mod_math.radians(latitude_1)
        lat2 = mod_math.radians(latitude_2)
        lon1 = mod_math.radians(longitude_1)
        lon2 = mod_math.radians(longitude_2)
        
        dlon = lon2 - lon1
        
        # Normalize dlon to [-pi, pi]
        while dlon > mod_math.pi:
            dlon -= 2 * mod_math.pi
        while dlon < -mod_math.pi:
            dlon += 2 * mod_math.pi
        
        dphi = mod_math.log(mod_math.tan(lat2 / 2 + mod_math.pi / 4) / 
                            mod_math.tan(lat1 / 2 + mod_math.pi / 4))
        
        q = (lat2 - lat1) / dphi if abs(dphi) > 1e-12 else mod_math.cos(lat1)
        
        course = mod_math.atan2(dlon, dphi)
        course = mod_math.degrees(course)
        
    else:
        # Great circle (orthodromic) course calculation
        lat1 = mod_math.radians(latitude_1)
        lat2 = mod_math.radians(latitude_2)
        lon1 = mod_math.radians(longitude_1)
        lon2 = mod_math.radians(longitude_2)
        
        dlon = lon2 - lon1
        
        y = mod_math.sin(dlon) * mod_math.cos(lat2)
        x = mod_math.cos(lat1) * mod_math.sin(lat2) - \
            mod_math.sin(lat1) * mod_math.cos(lat2) * mod_math.cos(dlon)
        
        course = mod_math.atan2(y, x)
        course = mod_math.degrees(course)
    
    # Normalize to 0-360 range
    course = course % 360
    if course < 0:
        course += 360
    
    return course
